name: Mickey and the Roadster Racers
description: Mickey Mouse and his pals Minnie, Pluto, Goofy, Daisy and Donald take their unique transforming vehicles on humorous high-spirited races around the globe as well as hometown capers in Hot Dog Hills.

videos.overview: The Happy Helpers help run a bed and breakfast but Clarabelle's eagerness creates problems.

videos.title: Goof Luck Charm
videos.overview: Goofy credits the good luck to his rubber duck and Daisy decides to borrow it.

videos.title: Teed Off!
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers work as caddies for a big golf tournament hosted by Mr. Bigby, but come at odds when a crazy groundhog, who loves to dance invades the golf course and causes havoc with other golfers with his antics.

videos.title: The Impossible Race
videos.overview: Cuckoo Loca participates in her first ever roadster event.

videos.title: The Happiest Helpers Cruise!
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers work as a cruise directors and help the cruise janitor Emmy Lou to win the disco dance contest.

videos.title: Smarty Goof
videos.overview: Goofy and Mickey compete with the Hot Dog Hills Invention Competition with the help of Professor Von Drake.

videos.title: Adventures in Buddysitting!
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers help the babysit kids and a goat named Buddy when the Hot Dog Hills Play Center is closed.

videos.title: Daredevil Goofy!
videos.overview: Goofy gets a chance to compete against the movie hero Morty McCool in a daredevil race.

videos.title: Mouse Vs. Machine!
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang are split up for a pit crew competition but Donald's team loses because he wasn't cooperating.

videos.title: Grandpa Beagle's Day Out
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers help Grandpa Beagle and Billy Beagle have family time.

videos.title: Donald’s Garage
videos.overview: Donald is left in charge while Mickey is away and he tries to improve the garage.

videos.title: Artful Helpers
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers are asked to guard a valuable painting at the Hot Dog Hills' Fancy Art Museum.

videos.title: Ready, Get Pet... Go Pluto!
videos.overview: Famous racer Danni Sue and her dog Dallas enter Hot Dog Hills' first Pets and Pistons Race,

videos.title: Figaro's New Friend!
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers look after Pluto, and Figaro gets jealous.

videos.title: Garage Alone
videos.overview: When a thief is on the loose, Goofy and Pluto try to protect the garage.

videos.title: Camp Happy Helpers
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers fill in as counselors for the day at a summer camp.

videos.title: The Haunted Hot Rod
videos.overview: Mickey decorates his roadster for Halloween.

videos.title: Pete's Ghostly Gala
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers help Pete for his Halloween Party.

videos.title: Billy Beagle’s Tip-Top Garage
videos.overview: Billy Beagle films the garage crew as they try to turn a junker into a winning roadster in one day

videos.title: Diner Dog Rescue
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers help a TV chef rescue the Hot Dog Diner.

videos.title: Pit Stop And Go
videos.overview: At the first "Pit Stop and Go" rally that is attended by Gordon Gear and Danni Sue, pit crews compete against each other to see who is the fastest and most efficient pit crew while avoiding obstacles in the race. Mickey has Donald, Chip, and Dale as his pit crew, Minnie, Daisy, and Cuckoo Loca are paired up with Danni Sue, and Goofy and Pluto are paired up with Gordon Gear.

videos.title: Alarm On The Farm
videos.overview: When Clara Cluck and her chicks go out of town for two days, the Happy Helpers agree to watch over her farm as farmworkers. During this time, the Happy Helpers have to milk the cow, feed the pigs, collect the eggs from the chickens, and have them ready for Clara Cluck's stand at the farmers' market.

videos.title: Hot Dog Daze Afternoon
videos.overview: Mickey Mouse takes a day off from his garage to take Pluto out to lunch and to the park. However, certain incidents cause him to be called back to the garage for him to handle.

videos.title: Super Sweet Helpers
videos.overview: Mrs. Sweetums hires the Happy Helpers to look after her candy store and factory while she goes to a candy convention in Bedford. Mayor McBeagle wants the Happy Helpers to fill a ginormous Hot Dog shape piñata for a Suprise Summer Celebration party for the citizens of Hot Dog Hills but Kaos breaks out as the candy making machines go haywire but in the process invented a new candy that is the hit of the party.

videos.title: The Grand Food Truck Rally
videos.overview: The Great Food Truck Rally is today as it will require the best road speed and kitchen skills to win it.

videos.title: Cuckoo La-La
videos.overview: When designer Cuckoo La-La enlists the Happy Helpers to help her out, Minnie and Daisy are thrilled to help out.

videos.title: Rockin’ Roadsters!
videos.overview: The gang is invited to compete in Billy B's Hot Rod Switcheroo!

videos.title: Safari, So Good
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers become safari guides for the day.

videos.title: Thrillin' Hilda!
videos.overview: When her skydiving lessons exhaust Tony enough to close down Tony's Skydiving School for a month, Hilda asks the Happy Helpers to help her find a new sport to play. She tries various things, but finally decides to participate in an obstacle course event hosted by Billy Beagle, though Hilda's opponent in this event is Pete's cousin Pineapple Patty.

videos.title: The Hot Diggity Dog Show
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers get called by Mr. Bigby to be pet groomers for the Hot Diggity Dog Show hosted by Robbie Roberts when the appointed groomer Caesar Du Flan gets infested with fleas. The dogs they must groom are Pluto, Butch, Mr. Doozy's dog Wanda, and a dog named Champ, whom Mr. Bigby is watching for Ivy Beaglesnoot, who broke her toe and can't be there. But things go wrong when Jinx gets into Corn Dog Stadium.

videos.title: The Hiking Honeybees
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers are contacted by Hilda to guide BeeBee Scouts Susie Beagleman, Buddy McBilly, and Elray Thunderboom through their forest hiking test when her assistant trail guide comes into contact with poison ivy. As Minnie was a former BeeBee Scout, Daisy plans to get her wings by following certain instructions with comical results.

videos.title: Cuckoo in Paris
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers visit Cuckoo La-La when she unveils her latest fashion collection presented by the rest of Cuckoo Loca's cousins Cuckoo Monet the painter, Cuckoo Angela the sculptor, Cuckoo E. Claire the baker, and Cuckoo Carmen the opera singer. While Cuckoo Loca gets to know her cousins the next day, Minnie and Daisy go on a trip to Notre-Dame de Paris where they meet Hunchback Pete and get an emergency call from Clarabelle to help with the banana bread orders.

videos.title: Super-Charged: Pop Star Helpers
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers are hired to get pop star Nina Glitter (Sabrina Carpenter). to her show on time.

videos.title: Grandpa vs. Grandpa
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers are hired by Auntie Olina to be judges for a Hawaiian surfing contest at the Banzai Pipeline hosted by Billy Beagle. As Mickey, Donald, Goofy and Pineapple Patty partake in the contest, the Happy Helpers learn about a lifelong rivalry between Grandpa Kai and Grandpa Beagle even after a waterspout strands the two grandfathers and the Happy Helpers on an island.

videos.title: A Doozy Night of Mystery
videos.overview: When Mr. Doozy invites everyone to his hotel for a dinner party, a family heirloom goes missing.

videos.title: Daisy's Photo Finish!
videos.overview: Minnie and Daisy travel to Brazil's Amazon rainforest to help Daisy's cousin Almanda de Quack get a picture of a rare bird called the kinglet calyptura as part of an urgent photo assignment for Brazil's biggest bird convention called the Conferencia de Pássaros, but the kinglet calyptura can only be found at the Pico da Neblina.

videos.title: Meet the Beagles!
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers are asked to help get a boy band back together.

videos.title: My Fair Pete
videos.overview: Pete worries that he won't be able to impress his mother when she comes for a visit.

videos.title: Tree House Trouble
videos.overview: When Chip and Dale have a roommate squabble, they ask the Happy Helpers to find them each a new home. While Chip bunks with Donald, Dale bunks with Goofy. After that ends in a disaster, the Happy Helpers look for some tree houses for Chip and Dale while hoping that they will move back in together.

videos.title: Mickey's Mixed-Up Motor Lab
videos.overview: Mickey invents a new Motor Lab to add new upgrades to the gang's roadsters for a town event.

videos.title: Wishy Washy Helpers
videos.overview: The Happy Helpers offer their services to make the Bigby Towers' windows sparkle and shine.

videos.title: One Unicorny Day!
videos.overview: When a horse gets a traffic cone stuck on her head and is sprayed with sparkly paint, the townsfolk think they've seen a real unicorn.

videos.title: The Happy Horse Helpers!
videos.overview: Minnie and Daisy are thrilled when a ranch owner asks them to give horseback riding lessons.

videos.title: Animal Antics
videos.overview: A Safari Park race provides a perfect opportunity for the gang to convert their roadsters into their favorite animals.

videos.title: Here, Kitty, Kitty, Kitty!
videos.overview: When Cmdr. Heist's kitty runs away because he is being mean, he asks the Happy Helpers to teach him how to be nice.
